summary: Operational tooling for CI doc-integrity enforcement, cross-platform CLI distribution, and production smoke testing. Keeps the doc spine lean and verifiable while lowering the barrier to adopt the bp CLI on any platform.

intentions.title: Enforce doc-spine integrity as a hard CI gate
intentions.evidence: docs-anchors-check.sh validates routing-table targets, INDEX entries, card Code anchors, G1 doc-tier headers, canonical-for uniqueness, and ARCHIVED banners — failing the gate on any violation

intentions.title: Keep agent-context docs lean and non-proliferating
intentions.evidence: check-doc-budgets.sh enforces per-file byte caps and a hard 7-card limit; remedy message explicitly forbids raising caps — forces content retirement over accumulation

intentions.title: Zero-friction cross-platform CLI onboarding
intentions.evidence: install-cli.sh (POSIX sh, curl|sh pattern, sha256 verification, /usr/local/bin fallback) and install-cli.ps1 + setup-windows.ps1 cover macOS/Linux and Windows with a single command

intentions.title: Verify media-platform feature surface end-to-end on prod
intentions.evidence: media-smoke.sh exercises upload, v1 detail + delivery URLs, search, collections, share links, governance checkout, and rendition serving against the live prod server in one script
